note: Gist read-after-write fix: a successful PATCH is now confirmed by its own 2xx response body (write receipt) before any read-back; read-after-write verification forces authenticated GET (anonymous GET can hit GitHub edge cache ~60s and return pre-write content); a stale verify mismatch no longer becomes preflightChanged and can never re-PATCH the same payload in one run; expired sync.backup.* cleanup is decoupled from the business PATCH and runs best-effort after a confirmed write (422 cleanup failures no longer fail the sync); 422 diagnostics now include the GitHub message/errors digest and per-file upsert/delete list.
